messages:
elaine-sales: Heads up — Sheridan Bank emailed the SIG v2 bundle and wants per-question artifacts + timelines. They specifically called out KMS rotation, network diagram for private deployment, and proof of disk/db encryption. Can security + SEs triage?

mike-se: On it. Copying Sam. Quick Q — do they accept screenshots + internal SOPs, or do they need signed artifacts? (they mentioned 'evidence packages')

sam-security: They usually accept screenshots + config snippets + a short narrative. For high-risk controls we'll provide policy PDFs. I'll own encryption/network answers. ETA EOD tomorrow for a first pass.

zoe-ps: FYI, Sheridan also asked if Dedicated (reserved capacity) can be in a customer VPC for the POC. I said yes, but we need to show the VPC peering diagram and firewall rule examples.

mike-se: Pricing note for the thread: Dedicated = monthly reserved + burst billing. I'll attach a sample quote for 2x A100 pools. Also confirm BYOK for KMS — we support AWS KMS & GCP KMS (customer-managed keys).

elaine-sales: Ok. Let's split tasks: Sam = controls answers & artifacts; Mike = config snippets + pricing; Zoe = network diagram + POC checklist. I'll send Sheridan a short timeline once we have artifacts.

sam-security: Starting the encryption answer now. Key points I'll include: AES-256-GCM for data-at-rest, disk-level encryption with cloud-managed keys, DB-level column encryption where required, KMS CMK rotation policy (90 days), and audit logs to CloudTrail/Stackdriver. Example snippet to prove rotation schedule:```aws kms list-key-rotation-status --key-id alias/redwood-prod``` I'll attach the rotation calendar screenshot.

mike-se: For config/artifacts I'll prepare: 1) sample terraform snippet showing KMS key attachment, 2) helm values for private deployment networkPolicy, 3) snapshot of billing estimate. Example terraform line:```resource "aws_kms_key" "redwood_prod" { description = "Prod CMK" enable_key_rotation = true }```

zoe-ps: Network diagram draft: VPC peering between Sheridan VPC <-> Redwood Dedicated VPC, NAT + limited egress, security groups limiting 443/22 to customer IP ranges, and flow logs enabled. I'll export PNG and PDF.

sam-security: Also adding SOC2 cert reference and pen-test summary (last test 2025-12-07, low-risk findings remediated). For SIG question 3.2.1 (encryption at rest) I'll attach: `SIG-3.2.1-encryption.pdf`, rotation SOP `KMS-rotation-SOP.pdf`, and a screenshot of key rotation UI.

infra-bot: Artifact uploaded: /artifacts/sheridan/SIG/2025-11-22/KMS-rotation-screenshot.png (uploaded by sam-security) :white_check_mark:

elaine-sales: Perfect. Sheridan asked if we can provide per-question filenames to speed ingestion into their vendor portal. Use convention `SIG-<QID>-<artifact>-<date>.pdf`.

mike-se: Agreed. I'll produce `SIG-3.2.1-enc-at-rest-2025-11-22.pdf` and `SIG-network-vpc-2025-11-22.pdf`.

sam-security: Quick blockers: need an exported network ACL screenshot from infra team and the DB encryption key ARN for the prod replica. Mike — can you pull the ARN?

mike-se: Yep — will grab ARN and paste here in 15m.

elaine-sales: Thanks all. I'll draft the cover email to Sheridan with the timeline (deliverables by EOD tomorrow) and attach the artifacts once uploaded. If anything slips, call it out here. :thumbsup:
